items.title: TTS-1 Technical Report
items.raw_content:
Authors: Oleg Atamanenko, Anna Chalova, Joseph Coombes, Nikki Cope, Phillip Dang et al.

We introduce Inworld TTS-1, a set of two Transformer-based autoregressive text-to-speech (TTS) models. Our largest model, TTS-1-Max, has 8.8B parameters and is designed for utmost quality and expressiveness in demanding applications. TTS-1 is our most efficient model, with 1.6B parameters, built for real-time speech synthesis and on-device use cases. By scaling train-time compute and applying a sequential process of pre-training, fine-tuning, and RL-alignment of the speech-language model (SpeechLM) component, both models achieve state-of-the-art performance on a variety of benchmarks, demonstrating exceptional quality relying purely on in-context learning of the speaker's voice. Inworld TTS-1 and TTS-1-Max can generate high-resolution 48 kHz speech with low latency, and support 11 languages with fine-grained emotional control and non-verbal vocalizations through audio markups. We additionally open-source our training and modeling code under an MIT license.
items.title_zh: TTS-1 技术报告
items.summary: Inworld introduces TTS-1, two autoregressive Transformer text-to-speech models: the 8.8B-parameter TTS-1-Max for quality and the 1.6B TTS-1 for real-time, on-device use. Both produce 48 kHz speech, support 11 languages and emotional control, and the training and modeling code is released under an MIT license.

items.title: Hierarchical Reasoning Model
items.title_zh: 分层推理模型（HRM）
items.summary: Researchers propose the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), a recurrent architecture with a high-level module for slow, abstract planning and a low-level module for rapid, detailed computation, inspired by hierarchical processing in the human brain. It is described as carrying out sequential reasoning tasks in a single forward pass without explicit supervision of intermediate steps, using only 27 million parameters.

items.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Geolocating Colonial Virginia Land Grants
items.title_zh: 基准测试：用大语言模型定位弗吉尼亚殖民地时期的土地授予记录
items.summary: The study evaluates six OpenAI models across three architectures on converting narrative Virginia land patent abstracts into latitude and longitude coordinates, releasing a digitized corpus of 5,471 abstracts from 1695-1732 and 43 verified test cases. The best single-call model, o3-2025-04-16, reached a mean error of 23 km, and a five-call ensemble reduced it to 19.2 km.

items.title: Interpretable Anomaly-Based DDoS Detection in AI-RAN with XAI and LLMs
items.title_zh: AI-RAN 中基于可解释异常检测的 DDoS 防御：结合 XAI 与 LLM
items.summary: The paper proposes an LLM-interpretable anomaly-based DDoS detection system for 5G radio access networks that trains an LSTM on multivariate key performance measures from E2 nodes, then applies LIME and SHAP to explain predictions and uses LLMs to turn them into natural-language insights. Experiments on real 5G data report an F1-score above 0.96.

items.title: Efficient Compositional Multi-tasking for On-device Large Language Models

items.title: Natural Language Processing for Tigrinya: Current State and Future Directions
items.title_zh: 提格里尼亚语的自然语言处理：现状与未来方向
items.summary: A survey reviews more than 50 studies from 2011 to 2025 on NLP for Tigrinya across fifteen downstream tasks, tracing a shift from rule-based systems to neural architectures and identifying resource scarcity and morphological complexity as key challenges.

items.title: Cluster Purge Loss: Structuring Transformer Embeddings for Equivalent Mutants Detection
items.title_zh: Cluster Purge Loss：为等价变异体检测构建 Transformer 嵌入结构
items.summary: The paper introduces Cluster Purge Loss, which combines cross-entropy with a deep metric-learning objective to structure transformer embeddings around semantic equivalence within each class. Using UniXCoder as the base model, it reports state-of-the-art equivalent mutant detection and a more interpretable embedding space.

items.title: RoCE BALBOA: Service-enhanced Data Center RDMA for SmartNICs
items.title_zh: RoCE BALBOA：面向 SmartNIC 的服务增强型数据中心 RDMA
items.summary: The paper presents RoCE BALBOA, an open-source, RoCE v2-compatible RDMA stack that scales to hundreds of queue pairs and is 100G-capable, intended as a basis for building accelerators and SmartNICs. Deployed on FPGAs in a cluster, it showed latency and performance comparable to commercial NICs, with use cases including encrypted traffic inspection and line-rate preprocessing for recommender systems.
